args.query: IRS SOI state to state migration adjusted gross income

sql: SELECT year, SUM(CASE WHEN origin_state_fips='25' AND dest_state_fips<>'25' THEN num_individuals ELSE 0 END) AS out_ind, SUM(CASE WHEN dest_state_fips='25' AND origin_state_fips<>'25' THEN num_individuals ELSE 0 END) AS in_ind, SUM(CASE WHEN origin_state_fips='25' AND dest_state_fips<>'25' THEN agi ELSE 0 END)/1e6 AS out_agi_b, SUM(CASE WHEN dest_state_fips='25' AND origin_state_fips<>'25' THEN agi ELSE 0 END)/1e6 AS in_agi_b FROM fiscal.county_migration_flows WHERE year IN (2020,2021,2022) AND (origin_state_fips='25' OR dest_state_fips='25') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
